notes: Letterhead (organisation name and two address lines) and the two footer lines are furniture; the organisation name is not a heading. The Bill to / Ship to boxes sit side by side (box by box reading order) and are plain address text that is not scored. The invoice-details table is a key/value table with no header row. In the items table the section rows (Paper & Printing, Ink & Toner, Delivery) span all five columns and repeat their text in every cell; the total rows span the first four columns and repeat their label. Cells with two lines (description plus a small grey detail line) are given joined by one space. Numbered notes use the typed marker "1)" with a hanging indent; the payment-method bullets are drawn by CSS (a small filled circle, no text). Currency amounts are in pounds without the sign.
